candidates.change_summary: Change pot update to use a constant value instead of msg.value.
Change pot reset to 1 instead of 0 after a win.
Delete the line that resets pot to 0 after a win.
Change the require check to accept a value of 11 instead of TICKET_AMOUNT.
Change the transfer to the bank to use a different fee amount (2).
Change the winner transfer to pot instead of (pot - FEE_AMOUNT).
Insert a line that sets pot to 0 before the winner transfer.
Move the pot update to after the randomness check.
Change `payable(bank).transfer(FEE_AMOUNT)` to `payable(msg.sender).transfer(FEE_AMOUNT)` so the fee goes to the player instead of the bank, altering the final pot distribution.
Replace `pot += msg.value` with `pot = msg.value` so the pot resets on every play, changing the amount transferred to the winner.
Replace `payable(msg.sender).transfer(pot - FEE_AMOUNT)` with `payable(msg.sender).transfer(pot)` so the winner receives the full pot without the fee deducted.
Change `pot = 0` to `pot = 1` inside the win branch, leaving a nonzero pot that affects subsequent payouts.
Delete the `pot = 0` statement so the pot is never reset after a win, accumulating value forever and distorting future payouts.
Delete the entire `if (random == 0)` block so no winner is ever paid out, leaving the pot growing but untouched, directly observable by never receiving a payout.
Replace `uint random = uint(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.timestamp, block.difficulty))) % 2` with `uint random = 0` so every call results in a win, changing the observable transfer behavior.

Replace `uint random = uint(keccak256(abi.encodePacked(block.timestamp, block.difficulty))) % 2` with `uint random = 1` so no payout ever occurs, directly observable by never receiving a winner transfer.
Change `require(msg.value == TICKET_AMOUNT)` to `require(msg.value == TICKET_AMOUNT + 1)` so the required ticket amount differs, altering who can call play and the pot value.
Change `payable(bank).transfer(FEE_AMOUNT)` to `payable(bank).transfer(FEE_AMOUNT + 1)` so the transferred fee amount differs, changing the pot available for the winner.
